summary: C7: default-switch announcement banner on /chat (one-time, dismissible)
description:
One-time dismissible banner on /chat for existing pro users
explaining the silent default-model change (Sonnet 4.5 → DeepSeek
V4 Pro). BRD §9 step 4. Without this the silent switch surprises
mid-session.

Files:
  - src/components/chat-view.tsx — small banner component at top
    of chat pane. Dismissed-state in localStorage with a versioned
    key (admin.banner.modelpicker.v1) so future banners can ship
    without un-dismissing this one.
  - src/__tests__/chat-view.test.ts (extend) — banner shows when
    localStorage key absent; hidden after dismiss; persists
    across reloads.

Banner copy:
    Pro now lets you pick your AI model. Default switched to
    DeepSeek for cost reasons — change it in Settings if you'd
    rather use Anthropic, OpenAI, or X.AI.

Done when:
  - Pro user's first /chat visit after deploy shows the banner.
  - Dismiss button removes banner + writes localStorage.
  - Reload doesn't re-show.
  - Free users never see it (pro-only check in render).
  - New signups post-launch may briefly see it; acceptable
    (smaller code, smaller foot-gun than gating on
    users.created_at < banner_release_date).

Tests: component-level, mocked localStorage.

Operator action post-merge: none.

Depends on: C5 (banner links to /settings; section must exist).
